prepared_report.purpose: prepared snapshot startup, no managed endpoint or universal performance claim
limitations: Shared WSL nested KVM and uncontrolled host background load
Persistent HyperMachine HTTP daemon versus fresh Firecracker process/Unix API
Prepared resident/cache-warm sources; no dropped-cache or storage durability comparison
PSS excludes kernel memory and unmapped page cache; not fleet density
Failed attempts retained; conditional latency and memory summaries
Engine-generated device kernel arguments differ

guest_restore_contract.hypermachine: acknowledged by successful create, source-bound after_restore
guest_restore_contract.firecracker: Restored RPC acknowledgement before exec; replaces readiness ping

prepared_report.node_log_tail:
HM_BOOT_IMAGE_MODE=owned
hv2-sandboxd: listening on 0.0.0.0:52617, capacity 128
  POST   /sandboxes                -- E2B-shaped (NewSandbox -> Sandbox), boots a real VM and its own process.Process gRPC listener (port in the response's processPort)
  POST   /sandboxes/{id}/exec     -- NOT E2B's envd protocol; a real exec_in_guest (simpler than grpcurl-ing processPort)
  POST   /sandboxes/{id}/connect  -- attach to an existing sandbox; what the E2B SDK's Sandbox.connect() calls
  DELETE /sandboxes/{id}          -- stop the VM and its process.Process listener
  PUT    /sandboxes/{id}/network  -- replace a running sandbox's egress rules
  POST   /sandboxes/{id}/pause    -- suspend to disk; connect or resume brings it back,          and with autoResume so does a request through the proxy
  POST   /sandboxes/{id}/fork     -- checkpoint in place, start `count` copies
  GET    /sandboxes/{id}/network/decisions -- NOT E2B's; the gateway's audit log
sandboxes get no network interface (--network to change that)
sandboxes are restored from template snapshots: base

sandbox proxy on 0.0.0.0:54083 -- HTTP/2, routed by the authority a client asks for, as 49983-<sandboxID>.<anything>
  grpcurl -plaintext -authority 49983-$SBX.local -H "X-Access-Token: $TOKEN" -import-path crates/hv2-api/proto -proto process.proto \
      -d '{"process":{"cmd":"/bin/sh","args":["-c","echo hi"]}}' \
      localhost:54083 process.Process/Start
